requests.result: Current public viewer HTML and JavaScript/configuration retrieved; cadastral map controls and service documentation inspected.

Official Chiayi cadastral-information service page retrieved; it documents cadastral maps, local land-office data custody, paid per-parcel map access, and authentication requirements for protected services.
Capabilities listed WFS:CADAS_MERGE titled 地籍圖.
Schema exposed safe candidate fields CITY, SECT, LANDNO and gml:multiPolygonProperty geometry; owner/address/title fields were not requested or retained.

requests.method: GET; anonymous; exact unchanged WUP point
requests.result: Response body was Permission Denied; no feature, ID, attributes, or geometry returned.
A non-cadastral public WFS control layer returned a FeatureCollection, showing the endpoint was reachable; no parcel inference made.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Cadastral layer existence and schema were verified, but anonymous parcel feature access at the exact WUP point was denied; citywide coverage and parcel inclusion remain unknown.

technicalBlocker: CADAS_MERGE GetFeature returned Permission Denied despite public capabilities and schema responses.
remainingUncertainty: The exact point may correspond to a parcel, but no safe anonymous feature response was available. A denied or zero-point response is not evidence of citywide absence.
nextStep: Serial reviewer may independently qualify a safe public geometry route without login, credentials, or unsafe fields.
